content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BNU Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the university website www.bnu.karnataka.gov.in. Fill the application form and attach marks cards, degree certificates, Ph.D/NET/SLET/K-SET certificates, research publication certificates, experience certificates, etc. Submit two copies of the filled application along with enclosures to the Registrar, Bengaluru North University administrative office. Make sure it reaches by 17 November 2026.
